CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.match_documents(query_embedding vector, match_threshold double precision, match_count integer)
 RETURNS TABLE(id text, content text, similarity double precision)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
begin
  return query
  select
    "ResourceEmbedding".id,
    "ResourceEmbedding".content,
    1 - ("ResourceEmbedding".embedding <=> query_embedding) as similarity
  from "ResourceEmbedding"
  where 1 - ("ResourceEmbedding".embedding <=> query_embedding) > match_threshold
  order by "ResourceEmbedding".embedding <=> query_embedding
  limit match_count;
end;
$function$
arguments: query_embedding vector, match_threshold double precision, match_count integer

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.make_me_admin()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  update public."Profile"
  set role = 'ADMIN'
  where id = auth.uid()::text;
  
  return 'Success: You are now an ADMIN. Try adding a course.';
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.am_i_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  is_admin boolean;
begin
  select (role = 'ADMIN') into is_admin
  from public."Profile"
  where id = auth.uid()::text;
  
  return coalesce(is_admin, false);
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO public."Profile" (
    id, 
    email, 
    "fullName", 
    username, 
    "universityId", 
    role, 
    "updatedAt" -- Added this to prevent the "null value" error
  )
  VALUES (
    new.id, 
    new.email, 
    new.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name', 
    new.raw_user_meta_data->>'username',
    new.raw_user_meta_data->>'universityId',
    'STUDENT',
    now()
  );
  RETURN new;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.check_conversation_access(convo_id text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public."ConversationParticipant"
    WHERE "conversationId" = convo_id
    AND "userId" = auth.uid()::text
    AND status = 'ACCEPTED'::"ConversationStatus"
  );
END;
$function$
